SELECT , , COALESCE(spent.total_amount, 0) AS spent_amount, COALESCE(spent.expense_count, 0) AS expense_count, ROUND(b.monthly_limit - COALESCE(spent.total_amount, 0), 2) AS remaining_amount, ROUND(COALESCE(spent.total_amount, 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(b.monthly_limit, 0), 2) AS usage_percentage FROM budgets b LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = b.category_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT SUM(e.amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS expense_count FROM expenses e WHERE e.user_id = b.user_id AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.expense_date) = b.year AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM e.expense_date) = b.month AND (b.category_id IS NULL OR e.category_id = b.category_id) ) spent ON TRUE WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND b.year = #{year} AND b.month = #{month} ORDER BY (b.category_id IS NULL) DESC, lower(c.name) ASC NULLS LAST
